**August Engineering Update**

We shipped the database migration ahead of schedule—infrastructure team coordinated two weeks of parallel reads across both systems to ensure zero downtime. The cutover ran clean, and we retired the legacy schema by end of month.

Two engineers joined us this month. Sarah starts in Backend tomorrow and comes from [Company]'s payments team. Marcus joins Frontend next week after five years at [Company] doing React at scale. Both will ramp on core services over the next two weeks; help them hit the ground by reviewing their PRs thoughtfully.

On blockers: the API latency work slipped by two weeks. We underestimated the query optimization work needed on the reporting service, and the first approach didn't pay off as expected. We've adjusted the plan—now focusing on index tuning instead of reshaping tables—and expect to hit the October deadline. This doesn't affect Q3 shipping plans.

All teams are ahead on their September goals except for the one item above. Weekly syncs resume Monday. If you notice anything blocking your work, flag it early rather than late.

—[Your name]
